SECTION 13: (1 ) Two or more subcontracting companies may co-contract.
(2) Co-contracting occurs when separate companies provide the
services covered by the contract as part of a consortium. The consortium may

- The consortium shall be severally liable when each subcontracting
company is bound by the entire subcontract and mu'st compensate for any

- The consortium shall be jointly liab!e when the services are divided into

authorized representative shall act on behalf of all the subcontmcting
companies in relation to the principal contracter or the project owner. Each
company shaii be paid through its own account.
